## Learning goals

- I can use colour for emphasis without making colour the only cue.
- I can measure text and graphic contrast.
- I can test the final screen, print, or fabricated result and revise it.

::: {.callout-note}
The lesson applies the [BBC guidance for visually and hearing impaired audiences](https://www.bbc.com/editorialguidelines/guidance/visually-and-hearing-impaired-audiences). WCAG 2.2 ratios are added so students have a measurable test as well as a visual comparison.
:::
